description: Selected Physiology-Driven Control Aware Network using future-control-aware recurrent decoding without explicit predicted-output physiological feedback.
Adds explicit feedback of the previous predicted HR/Tskin/Tcore into the next decoder step. This tests whether the old autoregressive-feedback mechanism improves or worsens the selected PDCAN.
Removes the encoder-level global future-control context while retaining minute-level future controls in the decoder.
Keeps the selected PDCAN architecture but removes the second-order trajectory smoothness regularization term.
Keeps the selected PDCAN trajectory decoder but removes the learned residual mPSI calibration head, leaving only the formula-based mPSI output.
